biggest_catch: You need your own truck, equipment, and 1+ year of professional experience — this is for real lawn-care operators, not beginners.
catches: Requires your own truck or van plus mower, trimmer, and blower — significant equipment costs if starting from zero.
The pro page screens for at least one year of professional lawn care experience.
Pay is per job with the payout shown upfront; weekly payouts run Monday-to-Wednesday.
Seasonal demand swings — winter work is limited to snow/leaf/gutter services in some metros.
